exact_holds.meaning: Table 7.1.1-1 explicitly preliminary; five interactions conceptually defined; sensor/mission-specific enumerations and DIV-2 schema not complete. Do not adopt general task command schema, mandatory fields, status code set or execution claims.

External Task is decomposed into internal Module Assignment; separate taskID vs assignmentID, request/response codes, state/status/health; TaskManager assignment decomposition intent does not prove executed mission or ISA command outcome.

SOSA edition invokes specific MORA V2.4/VICTORY V1.9/ANSI-VITA49.2 original specifications, including restricted companion portions; C239 inline list read but those original normative companion texts not audited. No fields, cardinality or endpoints invented from them.

82 printed interface items have V1.0 support grades and some starred optional endpoints; * means optional, **/*** denote receipt/VRT acknowledgment options. No blanket universal RF/EO-IR or deployment support inferred.

RF Conditioner-Receiver-Exciter and Emitter/Collector define distinct logical interfaces; only latter has RF aperture resources. Coax/fiber and digital transport alternatives do not evidence a specific installed cable, module count or universal physical chassis.
12 CRE rows marked Future; EO/IR module interaction definitions explicitly deferred. Do not turn future action control, receive data or imagery features into 2023 current conformance requirements.
Nine referenced modules explicitly NOT DEFINED this edition; tables offer illustrative functional/input-output relationships not required SvcV/stream/Observation types or implemented classes.

Five real native shall Rules for Storage/Retrieval Manager only (with conditional rule 10.5-5); NVMe/PXE/security associations do not give arbitrary whole-sensor or CSAPI Profile a required storage/battery/chassis facility.
NVMe Write Response row describes response to Read Command; original typo held, no fabricated corrected source normative API.
PDF text and printed label/structural descriptions read; figure pixel/arrow geometry and MORA native binary schemas unverified, plus original eight DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI files still uninspected.
